धि r. 6th cl. (धियति) To have hold, to keep, to possess. तुदा० प० सक०
अनिट् ।

धी (ओ ङ) ओधीङ् r. 4th cl. (धीयते)
 1. To contain, to hold.
 2. To light,
to disregard or despise.
 3. To accomplish. With अन्तर, To dis-
appear, to become invisible. दिवा० आ० सक० अनिट् ।

धी f. (-धीः) Understanding, intellect.
 E. ध्यै to meditate, affix क्विप्, the
final diphthong rejected, and the semi-vowel changed to its congen-
er इ, which becomes long. धै-सम्प-भावे-क्किप् ।
